import{functions}from'../firebase';import{httpsCallable}from'firebase/functions';class StripeService{constructor(){// Inicializar las referencias a las Cloud Functions
this.createConnectAccountFn=httpsCallable(functions,'createConnectAccount');this.getOnboardingStatusFn=httpsCallable(functions,'getOnboardingStatus');this.createPaymentIntentFn=httpsCallable(functions,'createPaymentIntent');this.claimPrizeFn=httpsCallable(functions,'claimPrize');this.getMyPrizesFn=httpsCallable(functions,'getMyPrizes');this.getPlatformBalanceFn=httpsCallable(functions,'getPlatformBalance');}// Crear cuenta Connect Express para un usuario
async createConnectAccount(email,fullName){let country=arguments.length>2&&arguments[2]!==undefined?arguments[2]:'MX';try{const result=await this.createConnectAccountFn({email,fullName,country});return result.data;}catch(error){console.error('Error creating Connect account:',error);throw new Error(error.message);}}// Obtener estado de onboarding de Stripe
async getOnboardingStatus(){try{const result=await this.getOnboardingStatusFn();return result.data;}catch(error){console.error('Error getting onboarding status:',error);throw new Error(error.message);}}// Crear PaymentIntent para pagos (inscripciones, cursos)
async createPaymentIntent(amount){let currency=arguments.length>1&&arguments[1]!==undefined?arguments[1]:'usd';let metadata=arguments.length>2&&arguments[2]!==undefined?arguments[2]:{};try{const result=await this.createPaymentIntentFn({amount,currency,metadata});return result.data;}catch(error){console.error('Error creating payment intent:',error);throw new Error(error.message);}}// Reclamar premio con código
async claimPrize(prizeCode){try{const result=await this.claimPrizeFn({prizeCode});return result.data;}catch(error){console.error('Error claiming prize:',error);throw new Error(error.message);}}// Obtener premios del usuario
async getMyPrizes(){try{const result=await this.getMyPrizesFn();return result.data;}catch(error){console.error('Error getting prizes:',error);throw new Error(error.message);}}// Obtener balance de la plataforma (solo admin)
async getPlatformBalance(){try{const result=await this.getPlatformBalanceFn();return result.data;}catch(error){console.error('Error getting platform balance:',error);throw new Error(error.message);}}}export default new StripeService();
